tools.name: find_best_offer
tools.description: Find the lowest current price for one named PC game. Compares live prices across the stores it tracks (Steam, GOG, Humble Store, Fanatical, Epic Games Store and others, in US dollars) and returns the cheapest store, every store price, the lowest price on record and a buy link to hand to the user. tools.name: top_deals
tools.description: List current PC game deals under a price, one row per game at its cheapest tracked store. Useful for gift ideas within a budget. Set max_price to 0 for games that are free right now. Set record_low to true to learn, for up to 25 deals, whether today's price matches the lowest price on record. Defaul

tools.name: compare_games
tools.description: Lowest current price for up to 10 PC games in one call, with the total. Useful for a wishlist or a gift list. Each game comes with its cheapest store, the lowest price on record and a buy link. Prices in US dollars.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Lists what is covered (PC games today), the stores compared, where prices come from, how fresh they are and what is not covered yet.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search PC games by name when the exact title is unknown or several games may match. Returns up to 8 matching games, each with an id and its lowest current price. Follow with fetch on a result id to get every store price. For one game whose name is known, use find_best_offer instead.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch every tracked store price for one game by an id returned from search (for example game:236717). Use it only after search. For a game known by name, use find_best_offer instead.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
